layout: Full-screen. Deep navy (#0B1B3B) background with subtle geometric pattern. Centered vertically. Mobile-first responsive.
elements: Top area (40%): TrialFit logo mark (dumbbell + shield icon, white) + brand name 'TrialFit' in bold white typography + tagline 'Your Gym Journey, Your Buddy' in smaller white/light text

Middle area (40%): Two large cards side by side (stacked on mobile). Card 1: person icon + 'I'm a Gym Seeker'. Card 2: certificate icon + 'I'm a Gym Buddy'. Cards have white bg, 20px radius, hover lift effect
Bottom area (20%): Text link 'Already have an account? Log in' in white/slate
notes: Make cards large and tappable (min 48px height). Gen Z needs visual energy, 40+ needs clear labels.
